name: Agent Skill Quality Loop
description: Prepare skills, subagents, bundles, and workflow templates for publication through quality and regression gates.
approval_boundaries: Do not promote maturity without representative evidence.

phases.name: Quality review
phases.instructions: Review triggers, overlap, workflow clarity, validation, and context cost.

phases.name: Workflow refinement
phases.instructions: Apply the smallest operational improvements to contracts and gates.

phases.name: Prompt regression coverage
phases.instructions: Add or update representative behavior checks when justified.

phases.name: Workflow dry run
phases.instructions: Dry-run the changed workflow or skill behavior.

phases.name: Documentation review
phases.instructions: Review catalog, guides, examples, and cross-links for drift.

phases.name: Repository validation
phases.instructions: Run repository validation and scoring commands.

phases.name: Publication handoff
phases.instructions: Reconcile findings, maturity, bundle changes, and next action.
